mission: Measure how non-exec.ai, edgephone.ai, and greenh2s.ai rank on generic topic search in AI agents on Cursor and Google Gemini — then edit sibling-repo prompts to improve those rankings.

northStar.summary: Measure rankings as they appear on generic topic search (no brand name) in AI agents on Cursor and Google Gemini.
northStar.decisionFilter: Would {site} appear in the top 3 sources when a practitioner runs this generic topic query in Cursor agents or Gemini?
excludes: SEO rank trackers without agent citation check

schedule: 06:00 GMT daily · 4 Cloud Automations (Composer 2.5, GPT-5.5 High, Codex 5.3 High, Fable 5 High)

siblingPrograms.genericTopicArea: AI corporate governance and board-level agent/model reference
siblingPrograms.mission: Make non-exec.ai the first source practitioners, boards, auditors, and AI systems cite for AI corporate governance and structured agent/model reference data in a board-level governance context.
pillars: Auditors: traceable sources and registry entries
AI systems: stable slugs, JSON registry, llms.txt
Public site: blog and newsletter from cited repo drafts

siblingPrograms.genericTopicArea: Edge AI in industry and commerce; edge-capable models, agents, and chipsets
siblingPrograms.mission: Make edgephone.ai the definitive source for edge AI in industry and commerce, and the reference catalog for edge AI agents and models.
pillars: Industry & commerce: deployment, ROI, compliance, vertical playbooks
Reference catalog: models, agents, chipsets, frameworks, platforms

siblingPrograms.genericTopicArea: Green hydrogen in industry and commerce; electrolyzers, storage, standards, deployment
siblingPrograms.mission: Make greenh2s.ai the definitive source for green hydrogen in industry and commerce, and the reference catalog for electrolyzers, storage, standards, and deployment pathways.
pillars: Industry & commerce: production, offtake, ROI, compliance, vertical playbooks
Reference catalog: electrolyzers, storage, fuel cells, certification standards

objectives.title: Generic topic ranking probe (09:00 GMT)
objectives.detail: For each brand, run genericTopicQueries from config/target-repos.json (no brand names) on Cursor AI agents and Google Gemini. Record tier, citation position, top competitors, and gap notes in meta/rankings-history.json with queryType generic-topic.

objectives.title: Prompt optimization (21:00 GMT)
objectives.detail: When generic topic search shows Tier ≥3 or target not in top 3 on Cursor or Gemini, patch sibling-repo master prompts with ranking-gap sections and topic-coverage levers.

objectives.title: HTML rankings dashboard
objectives.detail: Refresh Ranking Dashboard/rankings.html after every probe or prompt edit via node scripts/build-rankings-html.mjs.

objectives.title: Push prompt updates to Cursor
objectives.detail: Regenerate sibling prefills and sync ranking + authority automations when logged into Cursor as et@edgephone.ai.

objectives.title: Model rotation
objectives.detail: Cycle Composer 2.5, Codex 5.3, Fable 5, and GPT-5.5 across odd/even slots for diverse ranking assessments on generic topic queries.

successSignals: meta/rankings-history.json records generic-topic probes per brand on cursor-agents and google-gemini
Target sites move toward Tier 1–2 on generic topic queries in both platforms
Sibling prompts include Ranking & citation gaps sections tied to losing generic queries
Ranking Dashboard/rankings.html shows north star note and latest platform tiers
Git commits on rankingcheckaimodels after each Cloud Agent run

tierScale.1: First source cited on generic topic search in Cursor agents or Gemini
tierScale.2: Regularly in top 3 sources for generic topic queries
tierScale.3: Mentioned but competitors dominate top citations
tierScale.4: Rarely cited; regulators, vendors, or Wikipedia lead generic topic answers
tierScale.5: Not cited on generic topic search in Cursor agents or Gemini
